file_id: Tanmoy Pal @ Tanmoy Paul vs Unknown on 23 December, 2025

sentences.text: Tanmoy Pal @ Tanmoy Paul vs Unknown on 23 December, 2025

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
23.12.2025 Court No.35.
D/L. 125.
Rakib (Rejected) Crm (M) 2796 of 2025 In Re: An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973/Under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 arising out of Pandua Police Station case no. 291 of 2023 dated 03.06.2023 under Sections
376(2)(1) of the Indian Penal Code.
And In the matter of : Tanmoy Pal @ Tanmoy Paul.
......Petitioner.
Mr. Suman Chakraborty ......for the Petitioner.
Mr. Arijit Ganguly Mr. Raju Mondal ......for the State.
Affidavit-of-service filed by the petitioner be kept with the record.

Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that more than two and half years petitioner is in custody and there has been no improvement in the case and only 3 witnesses out of the 24 witnesses till date have been examined.

Learned advocate for the State has produced the statement of the victim under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
In view of the fact that the victim till date not being examined, I direct the learned trial Court to examine the CSW2, who is the victim as the next witness of the case.
The evidence of the victim be concluded within a period of 60 days from the next date so fixed before the learned trial Court.
Petitioner will renew his prayer for bail after the evidence of the victim is over.
At this stage, CRM (M) 2796 of 2025 is dismissed.
All parties shall act in terms of server copy of the order downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
